```lean
AlgebraicGeometry.affineLocally.{u}
  (P : {R S : Type u} → [inst : CommRing R] → [inst_1 : CommRing S] → (R →+* S) → Prop) : MorphismProperty Scheme
```
***
For `P` a property of ring homomorphisms, `affineLocally P` holds for `f : X ⟶ Y` if for each
affine open `U = Spec A ⊆ Y` and `V = Spec B ⊆ f ⁻¹' U`, the ring hom `A ⟶ B` satisfies `P`.
Also see `affineLocally_iff_affineOpens_le`.

  {P : {R S : Type u} → [inst : CommRing R] → [inst_1 : CommRing S] → (R →+* S) → Prop} (hP : RingHom.PropertyIsLocal P)
  {X Y : Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.OpenCover) [∀ (i : 𝒰.J), IsAffine (𝒰.obj i)]
  (𝒰' : (i : (𝒰.pullbackCover f).J) → ((𝒰.pullbackCover f).obj i).OpenCover)
  [∀ (i : (𝒰.pullbackCover f).J) (j : (𝒰' i).J), IsAffine ((𝒰' i).obj j)] :
  affineLocally P f ↔
    ∀ (i : (𝒰.pullbackCover f).J) (j : (𝒰' i).J), P (Scheme.Γ.map ((𝒰' i).map j ≫ pullback.snd f (𝒰.map i)).op)
